title: Periodical Repairs and Maintenance of 12m high GI trestle tower of Strait Island, North Button Island, Wilson Island, Middle Button, ASSE, Patrie Island, Sister Island, Narcondum Island, North Brother and Interview Island Lighthouses

money.notes: Bid document free of cost. EMD by deposit at call receipt/FDR/DD of any nationalised bank (Hindi version also allows bank guarantee) in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Sri Vijay Puram, valid 06 months from technical bid opening; originals with technical documents by post/hand by 13/08/2025 15:00. MSME/NSIC bidders registered for similar work exempt.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Eligible experienced civil contractors with successful completion of similar work of repair & maintenance of trestle towers including painting in Andaman & Nicobar Islands with Government organizations, without adverse remarks
Detailed eligibility as per Section-III clause 3.1 of tender document (not included)
notes: Scanned Section-I NIT: pages 1-3 Hindi, pages 4-6 English. File number differs between versions: Hindi CM-PB-01013/1/2022-CM-PB, English CM-PB-01004/1/2022-CM-PB. Technical bid opening subject to internet availability. No BOQ or Section-III eligibility included. ASSE = Andaman Strait Eastern Entrance; 'Patrie' matched to Petrie.
